Rough environmental storytelling layout. NPC lines are authored flavour; no mission rewards or ownership changes.

town.story: Cargo was hauled off the low quay into a dry warehouse. The customs house still has its records, but the family house is now a small first-aid post and the waiting hall holds stranded travellers.

places.name: Waiting hall / shelter
places.story: Waiting benches, luggage crates and a room now used as an overnight shelter.

places.name: North-bank family home
places.story: A family dining room looking down toward the bridge.

places.name: Quay tool shed
places.story: Rope and repair supplies are represented by a bench, toolbox and packed chest.

places.name: Dry warehouse
places.story: Cargo rescued from the low quay is stacked on the dry side of the road.

places.name: Customs house / lookout
places.story: Records and inspection tables below; a bridge-facing office above.

places.name: House / first-aid post
places.story: A family home converted to a two-bed first-aid post.

places.name: Vacated quay house
places.story: The household has packed; only a bare table and an open chest remain.

places.name: Bridge kitchen
places.story: A shared kitchen provides a reason for people on both banks to keep the bridge open.

places.name: Shelter store
places.story: Dry bedding and relief supplies, represented by stacked crates and chests.

sectorTemplate.scope: authored map; campaign compatibility still requires review

greeting.npc: We moved the cargo off the boards and into this warehouse. The bridge is the only dry crossing; please keep the road clear.
The waiting hall on the north bank is a shelter now. Anyone hurt comes here; anyone hungry goes to the kitchen south of the warehouse.
